subject: Intro: Summit Synergy (referred) — schedule demo & intake
body:
From: Mateo Ruiz <mateo@summitsynergy.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@partnersi.com
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interest from Integrum Ops — signed up via self-serve (referred)

Hi Priyom —

I work with Integrum Ops (Alicia Gomes is their engineering lead, cc’d). We had them try Redwood via the self-serve flow last week and they were impressed by the inference latency on short prompts. Marissa from our team recommended Redwood and suggested I intro you to move to a short demo / intake.

Alicia can do a technical demo next week. She also asked for a quick agenda (what you’ll cover) and any pre-demo checklist you want completed. I’ve attached a short intake I filled with Integrum’s basic environment details.

Quick context: Integrum is a logistics SaaS with ~80 engineers, looking to replace a home-grown GPU inference path. Reason for referral: we’ve run a successful pilot with one of our clients and thought Redwood would map well to their cost/latency needs.

Proposed first pass availability from Alicia: Tue 10/21 after 11am PT, Wed 10/22 9–11am PT, or Thu 10/23 10–11:30am PT.

Thanks — looking forward to the intro.

—
Mateo Ruiz
Partnerships, Summit Synergy
attachment: summit-intake-form.pdf (pdf)

---------------------------
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Ruiz <mateo@summitsynergy.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@partnersi.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest from Integrum Ops — signed up via self-serve (referred)

Thanks Mateo — really appreciate the intro and the intake.

Alicia / Integrum team: welcome. Short plan from our side: 30–40 minute technical walkthrough focused on integration patterns (private deployment vs hosted API), latency/throughput expectations, and a short Q&A with Ben (our SE). If time allows we’ll run a quick demo of a sample inference pipeline using a similar model class.

Can you confirm whether Integrum prefers: (A) an API-focused demo using your existing containerized model artifacts, or (B) a walkthrough of Redwood Dedicated/private options and security (VPC/KMS) first? Both are straightforward; we’ll tailor to the decision criteria you care most about.

Available slots from our side (PT):
- Tue 10/21: 11:30am–12:30pm
- Wed 10/22: 9:30–10:30am or 3:00–3:45pm
- Thu 10/23: 10:00–11:00am

I’ve attached a draft agenda and a proposed calendar invite (calendar-proposed.ics). If any of these work, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-demo checklist (API keys, model access, sample prompts).

Best,
Priyom
SDR, Redwood Inference
attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.docx; calendar-proposed.ics

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@partnersi.com>

Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, Mateo Ruiz <mateo@summitsynergy.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest from Integrum Ops — signed up via self-serve (referred)

Happy to help coordinate. Mateo — Alicia will be on PTO Mon–Tue morning but is back midday Tue and prefers Wed morning if possible. Alicia asked us to prioritize the Dedicated/private security discussion given they are regulated in parts of their flow.

Vanessa / Ben — I flagged two specifics in the intake form: (1) Integrum uses an internal SSO + on-prem artifact repository, (2) they want a quantization/throughput cost estimate for a 2–3 model family setup.

I can attend the call to help with partner context.

—
Marissa Cole
Partner Lead, PartnerSI

---------------------------
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomes <alicia.gomes@integrum-ops.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@partnersi.com, Mateo Ruiz <mateo@summitsynergy.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest from Integrum Ops — signed up via self-serve (referred)

Hi Alicia — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks Mateo and Marissa for the intro and context.

We’ll take Wed 10/22 9:30–10:10am PT for a 40-minute slot and will focus the agenda on:
1) quick intake confirmation (Priyom, 5 min)
2) security & deployment modes (Vanessa, 10–12 min)
3) integration patterns & demo of API flow (Ben, 15–18 min)
4) cost/quantization sketch and next steps (Ben/Vanessa, 5–10 min)

Please review the attached agenda and intake — if anything is missing, reply with notes and we’ll update before the meeting. I’ve sent a Google Calendar invite to all attendees (link below).

Meeting link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/DEAL-9982

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.docx, summit-intake-form.pdf

Looking forward — Vanessa
